title: [Master]-You must assign a serial number for item xxx" when trying to reverse Capacity Ledger Entry
summary: Manufacturing item journal posting no longer requires serial numbers for reversing capacity ledger entries with zero output, fixing an error when reversing capacity entries for serial-tracked items.
key_points: Disabled item tracking for reversing capacity ledger entries that have zero output quantity
Allows reversals of capacity entries without requiring serial number assignment
Specifically targets lines where Rev. Capacity Ledger Entry No. is set and Output Quantity is 0
quote: turn off item tracking for output lines that reverse a capacity entry (Rev. Capacity Ledger Entry No. <> 0) and have Output Quantity = 0
